baseline_models.mechanism: The choice verb supplies discrimination among alternatives, while knowledge supplies disclosed apprehension; the two عَلَى constructions present the comparison as informed rather than arbitrary.

activation_trace.role: Choosing or seeking the better option makes ٱخْتَرْنَٰهُمْ an active discrimination among possibilities.
A thing becoming clear to the knower supplies the epistemic basis on which the comparison is made.

changed_reading.before: They were simply preferred over others.
changed_reading.after: They were selected through a knowing discrimination across a field of alternatives.

baseline_models.mechanism: One branch of خ ي ر makes choice responsive to soundness or excellence already discerned by knowledge, so selection can recognize fitness rather than manufacture rank.

activation_trace.role: Virtue and chosen excellence supply a quality that selection may recognize in its object.
Clear apprehension makes the recognition of fitness informed and deliberate.

changed_reading.before: Election itself is the whole distinction.
changed_reading.after: Election may answer to a known fitness or excellence, with knowledge preceding the elevation.

baseline_models.mechanism: The beneficence branch keeps open the opposite causal direction from recognized excellence: informed choosing may bestow the good that constitutes distinction.

activation_trace.role: Beneficence and gift make choosing an allocation of good, not only a verdict about prior merit.
Knowledge as clear apprehension makes the gift knowingly fitted rather than indiscriminate.

changed_reading.before: They are chosen because they already possess superiority.
changed_reading.after: The choosing can itself confer a knowingly apportioned good, creating a distinction it does not merely detect.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: عِلْمٍ ... ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ, two occurrences of ع ل م around the second عَلَى
baseline_models.mechanism: The repeated root lets knowledge and worlds resonate through the branch of a distinguishing mark: the selected group can function as something made legible within the very field over which it is compared.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing mark that points beyond itself turns the doubled root into a semiotic link between knowing and the worlds.
Selection from alternatives supplies the act that makes one member conspicuous within the wider field.

changed_reading.before: The worlds are only competitors beneath a selected group.
changed_reading.after: The group may also be selected as a legible marker within and for the worlds, not merely placed atop a ranking.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence supplies registration, differentiation, and secure ordering; together they activate selection as formal designation into a bounded cohort with an assigned historical task.

activation_trace.role: Choice among alternatives supplies the focus act that the contextual procedure specifies.
A distinguishing mark supplies the legible identity produced by designation.
Entering a name in a register or cohort supplies formal enrollment as the institutional image for selection.
Distinguishing and separating two things supplies the classificatory operation behind enrollment.
Secure, exact ordering supplies stability and deliberateness to the designation.

structural_cues: 44:2-5 moves from a manifest book to differentiated wise affairs issued from with Us before the focus selection.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies registration, differentiation, and exact ordering; I infer that sequence as a procedural analogue for the choice in 44:32. Alternatively, it may describe revelation and decree generally without specifying how this group was selected.

changed_reading.before: Choice is an unstructured preference for a people.
changed_reading.after: Choice resembles entry into a knowingly differentiated cohort, a formal designation carrying a task.

context_deltas.mechanism: Mercy, formative lordship, and knowing converge before the historical episode, revising benefactive choice into informed cultivation rather than a one-time grant of rank.

activation_trace.role: Beneficence and gift keep the focus choice active as conferred good.
Mercy as tenderness supplies the governing affect of the gift.
Repairing, nurturing, and bringing to completion turn gift into an extended formative process.
Knowing through clear apprehension links that cultivation to the focus phrase عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ.

structural_cues: 44:6 places mercy from your Lord beside the Hearer and Knower before the account of rescue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mercy, nurturing lordship, and knowledge; I infer that these describe the quality and duration of the later choice. Alternatively, they may characterize the sending of revelation alone.

changed_reading.before: Selection is a completed bestowal of superior status.
changed_reading.after: Selection can be a merciful program of knowing cultivation toward completion.

context_deltas.mechanism: A demanded delivery of servants, nocturnal removal, and physical extraction from punishment make choice the completion of a transfer out of coercive ownership and into a new allegiance.

activation_trace.role: Choosing among alternatives supplies the decisive reassignment named by the focus verb.
Delivering a right or trust frames the demanded release as restitution, not opportunistic escape.
Bondage and ownership supply the contested jurisdiction from which the servants are recovered.
Night travel supplies the concealed movement by which reassignment becomes spatially real.
Scraping free and extracting supplies the physical release that grounds the later selection.

structural_cues: 44:18 demands Deliver to me the servants of God; 44:23 sends them by night; 44:24 opens a route; 44:30 names their rescue immediately before 44:32.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a restitution demand, escape route, and extraction; I infer that 44:32 names the positive jurisdictional result of that sequence. Alternatively, rescue and election may be successive but independent favors.

changed_reading.before: They are elevated as an already free collective over other collectives.
changed_reading.after: They are chosen by being reclaimed from degrading possession, so election first means liberation and reassignment of allegiance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus language of being over worlds follows a ban on self-exaltation and a portrait of Pharaoh's domineering height; granted elevation therefore reverses imperial elevation instead of licensing its repetition.

activation_trace.role: Chosen excellence supplies the legitimate distinction whose source must be contrasted with self-made height.
Knowing clearly supplies deliberation and accountability to the granted comparison.
Greatness as arrogance supplies the prohibited counterfeit of being over another.
Dominating ascendancy supplies Pharaoh's enacted model of illegitimate elevation.
Exceeding the limit marks the point at which elevation becomes transgression.

structural_cues: 44:19 says do not exalt yourselves over God, 44:31 calls Pharaoh high, and 44:32 repeats عَلَى around knowledge and worlds.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated height language and Pharaoh's transgressive domination; I infer a corrective reversal in the focus comparison. Alternatively, عَلَى in 44:32 may be ordinary comparison without an intentional echo of ع ل و.

changed_reading.before: Above the worlds authorizes a simple hierarchy and possession of superiority.
changed_reading.after: The elevation is an anti-Pharaonic reversal: granted distinction is legitimate only while it refuses self-exalting domination.

context_deltas.mechanism: A former order leaves effects and another people is made to inherit; the inheritance branch extending to knowledge, book, and virtue activates selection as succession into a vacated vocation rather than timeless essence.

activation_trace.role: Selection from alternatives supplies the appointment of a successor.
A distinguishing sign makes inherited vocation publicly legible.
Leaving an effect behind supplies the residue available for succession.
The transfer of knowledge, book, or virtue by inheritance turns succession from mere property transfer into vocation.
Standing in another's place supplies the functional role of the succeeding people.

structural_cues: 44:25-28 lists what the prior regime left and says it was made an inheritance for another people; 44:30-32 then moves to rescue and choice.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies abandoned goods, inheritance, and another people; I infer thematic succession into a vacated role. Alternatively, the other people in 44:28 need not be the pronoun group in 44:32, so the link may be analogical rather than referential.

changed_reading.before: Selection names an intrinsic and permanent identity.
changed_reading.after: Selection may appoint a successor to inherited knowledge and responsibility after a prior order forfeits its place.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately after selection, bestowed signs are called a manifest البلاء; split mapped branches preserve both ordeal and conspicuous benefaction, making favor itself the instrument that reveals the recipients' state.

activation_trace.role: Beneficence and gift supply the favorable face of selection.
A distinguishing mark supplies the revealing function that the following signs intensify.
A visible sign supplies the concrete gifts by which distinction becomes inspectable.
A test that makes the subject's condition appear supplies the diagnostic function of the gifts.
A witnessed good deed or benefaction preserves the coexisting favorable sense of the same البلاء.

structural_cues: 44:33 directly follows the choice and says the given signs contained a manifest البلاء.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies visible signs plus branches for both revealing test and conspicuous good; I infer that benefaction is the medium of examination. Alternatively, البلاء here may foreground favor alone, leaving testing only latent.

changed_reading.before: Choice and signs certify completed privilege.
changed_reading.after: Choice raises exposure: its gifts are simultaneously favor and a manifest assay that reveals what recipients do with distinction.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later text reopens the comparison with Are they better, recalls destroyed peoples, then separates and gathers all where allied status cannot avail; only mercy remains exceptional. This weakens any reading of 44:32 as unconditional immunity.

activation_trace.role: Chosen excellence supplies the rank claim whose scope the later sequence tests.
A renewed choice between alternatives reopens rather than permanently closes the question of comparative standing.
Falling into destruction supplies the historical failure mode of formerly powerful peoples.
A judgment that separates truth from falsehood supplies the final criterion beyond inherited rank.
Loving alliance and support supply the corporate bond explicitly unable to transfer rescue at judgment.
Mercy as tenderness supplies the stated exception after status and alliance fail.

structural_cues: 44:37 asks who is better; 44:40 gathers all for separation; 44:41 denies one ally can avail another; 44:42 excepts the recipient of mercy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a reopened خير comparison, destruction, universal separation, failed alliance, and mercy; I infer these as limits on the duration and legal force of 44:32's rank. Alternatively, the warning directly addresses current deniers rather than the ancestors selected in 44:32.

changed_reading.before: Being chosen above worlds is an inheritable guarantee against later reversal.
changed_reading.after: The distinction is historically real but neither irrevocable nor transferable; judgment re-evaluates persons and leaves mercy, not corporate rank, decisive.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured creation in truth is contrasted with the ignorance of the majority, activating عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ as a qualitative criterion that can run against numerical dominance.

activation_trace.role: Clear knowledge supplies the non-numerical ground of the focus comparison.
Measuring and proportioning supplies a calibrated rather than crowd-based comparison.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies the qualitative standard of that measure.
Competing or prevailing by number supplies the rejected alternative standard.
The majority's lack of clear apprehension sharpens the contrast between knowledge and count.

structural_cues: 44:38 denies play in creation; 44:39 grounds it in truth but says most of them do not know.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies proportioned creation, truth, majority, and ignorance; I infer that these retroactively specify the focus choice as qualitative rather than numerical. Alternatively, 44:39 may concern cosmology alone and not the criterion of election.

changed_reading.before: Above the worlds sounds like winning a contest of collective magnitude.
changed_reading.after: The comparison can privilege truth-responsive quality known by measure even when it stands against the majority.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing facilitation of the discourse in a tongue for recollection turns the selected people's history into a communicable sign for present hearers; selection operates at the level of narrated exemplarity as well as past status.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing mark that guides to something lets the chosen history function as an outward-pointing example.
Opening into ease after difficulty supplies accessibility to the narrated sign.
Using the tongue to convey a message supplies the channel by which the historical distinction reaches a new audience.
A reminder that makes one remember supplies the present function of recounting the choice.

structural_cues: 44:58 closes the whole historical and eschatological discourse by saying it was facilitated in your tongue so that they may remember.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies facilitated communication and recollection; I infer that the focus episode is among the signs selected for that pedagogical work. Alternatively, the pronoun in 44:58 may refer only to the message as a whole, without making the selected people themselves exemplary.

changed_reading.before: 44:32 only reports a closed privilege in past history.
changed_reading.after: It also selects that history as a portable reminder, making the people a legible exemplar for hearers beyond them.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because fringe branches of both focus roots independently converge on hyena imagery: one is coaxed from a burrow by blocking an opening, while the other names a male hyena. It remains anchored by that double focus-root convergence and by the packet's night movement, open gap, pursuit, and extraction; downstream prose must present it only as a structural analogy, never as the lexical translation of 44:32.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ٱخْتَرْنَٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ, activated by the routed escape in 44:23-30

activation_trace.role: Coaxing an animal from its burrow by obstructing one opening supplies a forced alternative-exit image for selection.
The male hyena named by this branch independently meets the animal in the خ ي ر branch, tightening an otherwise distant convergence.
Night travel supplies concealed emergence from the threatened enclosure.
A broad open gap supplies the alternative aperture through which the group is routed.
Pursuit that catches up supplies pressure driving movement through the opened route.
Scraping free and extracting supplies the completed emergence from confinement.

changed_reading.before: Choice is static honor conferred after rescue.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory route-model, choice is the knowledgeable eliciting of a concealed group through a newly opened exit while pursuit closes the former habitat.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a branch-distant hydrological activation, not a proposed dictionary sense for عِلْمٍ. It remains worth carrying because the focus inventory itself offers gathered abundant water and the immediate history repeatedly moves through sea and springs; downstream prose should mark it as a metaphor for the breadth and stored depth of the knowledge underwriting choice.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ, with the water sequence surrounding 44:24-32

activation_trace.role: A large gathered body of water supplies a reservoir image for the knowledge beneath the decision.
Choosing among options supplies the decision drawing on that reservoir.
Wide abundant water supplies the large-scale contextual analogue for gathered knowledge.
A flowing water source supplies distributed outlets from the larger reservoir image.

changed_reading.before: Knowledge is a single proposition explaining why they were chosen.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the choice rests on a gathered reservoir of knowledge with many sources and consequences, not on one disclosed criterion.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The raptor and lookout combination is surprising and crosses lexical domains, but it is anchored in a focus-root branch and reinforced by the surah's elevated watching, sky, and eye cues. It should be rendered only as an aerial-survey analogy for comprehensive selection, not as a claim that عِلْمٍ denotes a bird here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ عَلَى ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ, especially the elevated force of عَلَى

activation_trace.role: A named raptor supplies the mobile high-vantage observer in the exploratory model.
Choosing among alternatives supplies the discriminating act performed from that vantage.
An elevated observation post supplies the stable survey point for watchful comparison.
Height and elevation extend the survey vertically across the comparison field.
The seeing eye supplies visual discrimination within the aerial-survey analogy.

changed_reading.before: On knowledge states abstract omniscience without a viewpoint.
changed_reading.after: As a contained analogy, the selection is a panoramic survey from an elevated watchpoint, distinguishing one trajectory across many worlds.

strongest_changes: The rescue sequence revises election into liberation and jurisdictional reassignment before it becomes rank.
Pharaoh's self-exaltation turns above the worlds into an anti-imperial reversal rather than a license to dominate.
The signs and البلاء of 44:33 make favor and revealing trial simultaneous.
The renewed خير comparison and universal judgment weaken any permanent or transferable immunity.
The final facilitation in a tongue turns the chosen history into a present pedagogical sign.
summary.what_was_special: The doubled ع ل م in knowledge and worlds supported a semiotic reading, while context repeatedly changed the causal direction of خ ي ر: selection can recognize excellence, confer good, extract from bondage, appoint a successor, expose to trial, and make an example. The most unusual live trace was the independent convergence of both focus roots on the same hyena-and-exit image, reinforced by the escape route.
remaining_uncertainties: عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ may state divine manner, a known criterion, or both; the packet does not force one syntax-to-causality mapping.
The another people who inherit in 44:28 are not explicitly identified with the pronoun group in 44:32.
The animal, water, and aerial-survey outliers are structural analogies from valid branches, not direct lexical renderings.
The ع ل م resonance between عِلْم and عَٰلَمِين may be rhetorically active or merely etymological background.
